text: With scope locked, this is the first real architecture decision: the Warranty_Claim__c object, field by field.
Status__c, Product__c, Purchase_Date__c, Issue_Description__c, and Resolution_Notes__c capture the claim itself.
Claim_Amount__c is its own Currency field, not text, because a number nobody can report on or total isn't useful.
Region__c is stored directly on the claim so the routing Flow and sharing rule both have a stable value to act on.
Lookups to Account and Contact tie every claim back to exactly who it belongs to. Next: building the security model this data depends on.
